full_judgment: 2. Short facts relevant for the purpose of the case are that, petitioner Md Habibur Rahman Paikar as plaintiff instituted a suit in the 2nd Court of Munsif, Sadar Bogra, being, other Class Suit No. 157 of 1977, praying for declaration of his title in the suit land alleging, inter alia, that the suit land comprising an area of 1762½ acres out of 3525 acres of land originally belonged to Ram Chandra Datta, who subsequently settled the said land to one Najir Sheikh on receipt of proper nazar salami. Nazir Sheikh owned and possessed the suit land by construction of huts in a portion thereof and the remaining portion of the said land by way of cultivation. While being in rightful possession of the suit property, Najir Shaikh sold the entire suit land to one Chunu Sheikh and Tapun Bibi by a registered kabala dated 25-4-1953. Subsequently the said purchasers transferred their share of the land to Keamotullah Pramanik, Jobeda Khatun and Jamela Khatun by 'Pattakpatra' deed bearing No.8641. It was further alleged that Keamotullah, Jobeda and Jomela sold on 6-7-1954, 176½ acres of land to one Ishaque Uddin who owned and possessed the same. Thereafter Ishaque Uddin on 14-9-1957 sold 1762½ acres of land to Solaiman Pramanik who in his turn owned and possessed the same. Thereafter he sold that said land to Haji Md Baharuddin Paiker who subsequently transferred the said land to his son the plaintiff, on 19-4-1973 by a heba-bil-ewaz deed. It was further alleged that the MRR Khatian did not record the name of the vendor of the plaintiff due to sheer mistake and this clouded his title on the suit land as a result of which the suit land was not recorded in the name of the plaintiff and hence the suit for removing the cloud cast over his title.
